rationale: New focal-loss classifier passes 4/7 at default HPs with a different failure pattern than 16-iter saturated xgb_strict_win — W5 now passes (was strict_win's chronic fail), W6 fails only on n_trades=16, W1/W2 fail because focal at gamma=2.0 sharpens predictions toward thr=0.6 with low-WR picks; sweeping focal_alpha (try 0.25-0.4 to balance the 22% pos_rate) and focal_gamma (try 0.5-1.5 for softer focus) should spread predictions and lift trade count without re-introducing strict_win's W5 weakness.
